theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  classical
  let f : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hfin : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := by
    apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_mem_finset (Finset.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)))
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Icc, Prod.mk.injEq] at hx ⊢
    rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨n, by simp_all [hB]⟩
  have h_inj : ¬ Function.Injective f := by
    intro h_inj
    have h_inf : Set.Infinite (Set.range f) := Set.infinite_range_of_injective h_inj
    exact Set.not_infinite.mpr hfin h_inf
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ := h_inj
  have hij' : i < j ∨ j < i := by omega
  cases hij'
  · refine' ⟨i, j - i, by omega, _⟩
    intro n hn
    have h_periodic : ∀ k, u (i + k) = u (j + k) := by
      intro k
      induction' k using Nat.strong_induction_on with k ih
      match k with
      | 0 => simp [h_eq]
      | 1 => simp [h_eq]
      | 2 => simp [h_eq]
      | 3 => simp [h_eq]
      | k + 4 =>
        have h₁ := hu (i + k + 4) (by omega)
        have h₂ := hu (j + k + 4) (by omega)
        rw [h₁, h₂]
        norm_cast
        rw [ih (i + k + 3) (by omega), ih (i + k + 2) (by omega), ih (i + k + 1) (by omega), ih (i + k) (by omega)]
        rw [ih (j + k + 3) (by omega), ih (j + k + 2) (by omega), ih (j + k + 1) (by omega), ih (j + k) (by omega)]
    rw [h_periodic (n - i)]
    omega
  · refine' ⟨j, i - j, by omega, _⟩
    intro n hn
    have h_periodic : ∀ k, u (j + k) = u (i + k) := by
      intro k
      induction' k using Nat.strong_induction_on with k ih
      match k with
      | 0 => simp [h_eq]
      | 1 => simp [h_eq]
      | 2 => simp [h_eq]
      | 3 => simp [h_eq]
      | k + 4 =>
        have h₁ := hu (j + k + 4) (by omega)
        have h₂ := hu (i + k + 4) (by omega)
        rw [h₁, h₂]
        norm_cast
        rw [ih (j + k + 3) (by omega), ih (j + k + 2) (by omega), ih (j + k + 1) (by omega), ih (j + k) (by omega)]
        rw [ih (i + k + 3) (by omega), ih (i + k + 2) (by omega), ih (i + k + 1) (by omega), ih (i + k) (by omega)]
    rw [h_periodic (n - j)]
    omega
